Population density of the world

How crowded each country is, in people per square kilometer. The steps are uneven on purpose: density runs from under 1 in Greenland to over 18,000 in Monaco, so each step is roughly two to three times the one before.

Tap the map to open it full screen, then pinch to zoom and drag to move. Tap a country for its density.Click the map to open it full screen, then scroll to zoom and drag to move. Hover a country for its density.

Source: World Bank (EN.POP.DNST), 2023 data. People per km² of land area. Taiwan, Kosovo and Vatican City from national statistics (2023–2024 figures).

Gray means no data, as for Antarctica, Western Sahara and most small territories. Hatching marks areas whose ownership is unsettled (Kashmir, the Southern Kuril Islands). Circles mark small countries and territories that are too small to see at this scale; they are shaded by their density and pushed apart where crowded. Borders: Natural Earth (public domain), drawn in the Equal Earth projection, which keeps areas true to size.
